name: Agent Assistant
description: A shared RHS conversation interface for chatting with an existing agent bot through Mattermost.

settings_schema.header: Connect Agent Assistant to an existing Mattermost bot and team. These settings are installation-specific and must be supplied by a Mattermost administrator.
settings_schema.footer: The plugin contains no bot or provider credentials. Users may select any channel they belong to in the configured team; the bot and its gateway must also be able to process messages in each selected channel.

settings.help_text: Required. URL-safe team name from the Mattermost URL, for example: your-team-name.
Required. URL-safe preferred channel. It is selected only for users who have joined it; other users start in their first accessible channel and can choose another.
Required. Username of an existing Mattermost bot connected to the agent service. Do not enter an access token here.
